_edit: This is the only file to update for a Wednesday. Use plain dates like Wednesday, October 7 · 6:30 PM (Eastern). Leave a string empty to hide it. Do not add a maps or signup URL unless it is a real http(s) link. Prefix unfinished copy with PLACEHOLDER. Set sample to false when this week is real. Chapel = high school, Annex = junior high. Never call Oakland home. Never add student names, contacts, or prayer requests.
